notes:
Summary: Deflectra is a mid-market contact center SaaS vendor (multi-tenant) that wants to reduce live agent load by 40-60% via automated chat deflection and lightweight agent-assist. They operate a global support fleet with expected seasonal spikes (holiday campaigns) and strict SLAs for chat routing.

What they told us: 'We need predictable unit economics — if the math doesn't show deflection wins net of extra infra, procurement won't greenlight.' CTO worries about token costs and tail latency during spikes. Prefer models that can be quantized and deployed close to customers (VPC/region pinning).

Technical requirements / constraints: p95 latency target <= 400ms for deflection path; throughput goal 200-300 rps sustained per region during peak; average request ~30-60 tokens; median session length ~6 interactions. Cost sensitivity: aiming for <$0.02 per deflected session (model + infra) to meet margin goals. Need audit logs for every request and ability to redact PII on ingest.

Preferred approach discussed: start with hosted_api + Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + KV prefix caching) to prove unit-economics, then evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput if cost model favors it. Interested in quantization profiles and recommended batch sizes; wants price book for various quantization + batch combos.

Sales/eng interactions: AE Sofia intro call 2025-11-12. SE Evan did architecture review 2025-11-20. Security kickoff 2026-01-10 (requested SOC2 evidence + KMS integration guide). POC scope agreed 2026-02-12 (72h traffic replay + A/B: baseline hosted vs hosted+optimize).

Quote/ask: Immediate ask is 3-day POC runbook + canned cost-per-deflection report template. Also needs a fallback policy doc for model degradation scenarios.

Signals: very engaged, fast decision cadence if POC hits the cost target. Procurement cycle expects sign-off within 6 weeks after successful POC.
